856-4321-5147-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5147-8347.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1339-1832-4050-4063.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-4050-4063.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7175-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7175-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7175-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

38-659-4460.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-4460.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

2113-3459-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2113-3459-5078-6650.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6753-6965.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Sailor of Means

1409-4365-5424.description:
Activate Sailor of Means by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sailor of Means enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sailor of Means.
Resolve the Sailor of Means trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2366-4452-5414-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4452-5414-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1385-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1385-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

2921-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-2196-2701-4863.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1170-2196-2701-4863.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.

1429-2018-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Lesser Masticore didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Lesser Masticore is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

624-997-5011.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1819-5510-5511-5513.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of copies of Shadowborn Apostle in your library greater than your maximum hand size minus the number of cards in your hand.
1819-5510-5511-5513.description:
Cast Secret Salvage by paying {3}{B}{B}, exiling Shadowborn Apostle from your graveyard and causing you to search your library for all copies of Shadowborn Apostle in your library and put them into your hand.
Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Move to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size, ensuring to discard as many copies of Shadowborn Apostle as possible.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card discarded this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
During the next player's turn, cast Surgical Extraction by paying {B/P}, exiling all copies of Shadowborn Apostle from your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card exiled this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.

528-1407-2615.notablePrerequisites: You do not control a Construct.
528-1407-2615.description:
Activate Dollhouse of Horrors by paying {1}, tapping it and exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard, creating a token copy of Tree of Perdition that is a 0/0 Construct with haste.
When the Tree of Perdition token enters the battlefield, Corpse Knight triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition token by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Resolve the Corpse Knight trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
The opponent whose life total was swapped loses the game due to having zero or les life.

186-1978-3371.notablePrerequisites: Codie does not have summoning sickness.
186-1978-3371.description:
Activate Codie by paying {3} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Codie.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand, and on subsequent turns.

240-4050-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Egg or a creature with changeling.
240-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a nontoken Egg or a nontoken creature with changeling, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Atla Palani and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Atla Palani trigger, revealing the creature from the top of your library and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2816-2916-4231-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Pippin does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Pippin.
2816-2916-4231-4659.description:
Activate Pippin's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two Food, two Clue and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two of the tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Pippin by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1430-3382-4191-4600.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying {0}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Barrin.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, returning Barrin from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Barrin by paying {0}.
When Barrin enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, returning Mirror Image from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

224-596-1737-4832.notablePrerequisites:
Ensoul Artifact attached to Prototype Portal.
Prototype Portal does not have summoning sickness.
224-596-1737-4832.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by tapping it, creating a token copy of Darksteel Citadel.
When the Darksteel Citadel token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

1429-1636-2034-2204.notablePrerequisites: Scholar of New Horizons does not have summoning sickness.
1429-1636-2034-2204.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {C}{C}.
Lesser Masticore dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Scholar of New Horizons by tapping it and removing the -1/-1 counter from Lesser Masticore, causing you to search your library for a Plains card and either put it onto the battlefield or put it into your hand.
Repeat.

215-527-3464.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-3464.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{G}{G}
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Selvala.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2678-3263-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Renowned Weaponsmith.
Renowned Weaponsmith does not have summoning sickness.
2678-3263-3525.description:
Activate Renowned Weaponsmith by tapping it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first activated ability by paying {1}, untapping Renowned Weaponsmith.
Repeat.

232-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, exiling Priest of Urabrask and then returning it to the battlefield.
Priest of Urabrask triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
